findings.competence: Set up a time-position law for a uniformly accelerated motion with initial conditions (a term in t that contains t²)
findings.evidence: unter Angabe der Anfangsbedingungen ein Zeit-Ort-Gesetz formulieren
findings.note: Only catalog goal that develops time-position laws. If Freier Fall is meant to develop the law itself, the maths is still missing: neither f08d06dc 'Terme mit Variablen lesen und deuten' nor d658e26a 'Potenzen mit natürlichen Exponenten deuten und berechnen' is secured here.

findings.competence: Instantaneous rate of change as the limit of average rates; the tangent slope at a point of a graph
findings.evidence: Momentangeschwindigkeit für einen Zeitpunkt bestimmen ... im t-s-Diagramm als Sekanten- beziehungsweise Tangentensteigung deuten
findings.note: Only ae20183e is secured. Same competence in 7156558c (grade 10) and b1dcc191.

findings.competence: Acceleration as a physical quantity, needed to draw and read t-a diagrams
findings.evidence: in t-s-, t-v- und t-a-Diagrammen darstellen und interpretieren
findings.note: Acceleration is developed only in e4b38061, which requires this goal transitively.

findings.competence: Velocity as a defined quantity and, for non-uniform motion, instantaneous velocity, needed for t-v diagrams
findings.evidence: in ... t-v- ... Diagrammen darstellen und interpretieren
findings.note: Average velocity is available through ae20183e and the Sek I t-s diagram goal.

findings.competence: Friction as an effect (force) that brakes motion
findings.evidence: die verwendeten Idealisierungen wie Massepunkt und Reibungsfreiheit begründen und die Grenzen der Modellvorhersagen angeben
findings.note: If an everyday notion of friction is accepted, this finding falls away. Later alternative: 5fd45dbc.

remarks: Read 'beschreiben' and 'darstellen' in the minimal, qualitative sense. If the t-s description in e4b38061 includes s = ½·a·t² or the parabola, powers and quadratic functions would be missing. No goal in the block secures a quadratic-function goal. Main pattern: the chain begins with ce431132, whose description already uses t-v and t-a diagrams while velocity and acceleration are defined only in its successors. The tangent concept is secured for no goal in the block. Not reported as everyday knowledge: air resistance, road conditions, unit conversion, best-fit line by eye.
